back: Being without work, available to start work and actively seeking it at the going wage rate.
Unemployed ÷ labour force × 100, where the labour force is employed plus unemployed.
Short-term unemployment while people are between jobs or searching for their first job.
Unemployment caused by a mismatch of skills or location after the structure of the economy changes; it is long-lasting.
Unemployment caused by low aggregate demand in a slowdown or recession (demand-deficient).

front: Name two reasons why official unemployment figures can be misleading.
back: Discouraged workers and underemployment (and the informal sector) are not counted as unemployed.

front: How does unemployment affect the government budget?
back: Lower tax revenue and higher spending on benefits or social support.
Unemployment caused by regular seasonal falls in demand for labour, for example in farming or tourism.
